name: Baraat ghodi
description: A white baraat horse, dressed in its wedding finery, gallops across the page with its legs really moving, then the invite appears.

name: Elephant procession
description: Two decorated elephants walk in from either side, meet below your text and raise their trunks in welcome.

name: Peacock dance
description: A peacock fans its tail open feather by feather beneath your words.

name: Rose petals
description: Painted rose petals tumble down the page while your text rises in.

name: Marigold garlands
description: Strings of marigolds drop from the top of the page and sway, the classic Haldi and mandap look.

name: Diya lights
description: A row of clay diyas rises in under your text and the lamps light up one by one.

name: Swinging lanterns
description: Brass lanterns drop in on chains and swing gently, glowing.

name: Sky lanterns
description: Glowing sky lanterns rise from below and drift up past your text.

name: Palace doors
description: Carved palace doors cover the page, then swing open to reveal your invite.

name: Lotus bloom
description: A lotus bud rises from the water and opens, with ripples and floating leaves.

name: Kalash blessing
description: A brass kalash rises in a golden glow while marigolds drift down: a blessing to open the invite.

name: Mehendi
description: A henna mandala draws itself in behind your text, line by line.

name: Parrots
description: Green parrots fly across the page, wings beating.

name: Butterflies
description: Butterflies flutter in and settle around your text.

name: Golden sparkles
description: Soft gold fireworks burst above your text and twinkle around it.

name: Floating clouds
description: Soft, see-through clouds drift slowly across the sky above and below your words, never over them.

name: Royal welcome
description: Two decorated elephants walk in beneath your words while royal hand fans rise on either side and rose petals drift down.

name: Royal court
description: Crystal chandeliers drop in on their chains, royal fans wave at the sides and soft gold sparkles twinkle.

name: Lotus lake
description: A pair of crowned swans glides in on a lotus lake while lily pads bob on the water.

name: Moonlit lake
description: A golden crescent moon rises over a still lotus lake as fireflies drift upwards.

name: Baraat with parasols
description: The baraat ghodi gallops across while royal parasols rise on either side of your invite.

name: Doli arrival
description: A bridal doli travels in along the bottom under a marigold toran, with rose petals falling.

name: Rajasthani camel
description: A decorated Rajasthani camel walks in below brass temple bells and twinkling gold paisleys.

name: Toran welcome
description: A mango-leaf and marigold toran drops across the top, brass bells swing, and diyas light up below.

name: Floral arch
description: A lush arch of roses, jasmine and marigolds blooms around your words as flowers drift down and butterflies flutter.

name: Garden corners
description: Floral bouquets grow into all four corners while butterflies flutter round the page.

name: Madhubani fish
description: A Madhubani fish pair, the Mithila symbol of a happy marriage, turns gently beneath a henna mandala.

name: Rangoli
description: A rangoli spins slowly into place below your words under a marigold toran, with glowing embers rising.

name: Jasmine rain
description: Strings of jasmine gajra hang from the corners and single blooms fall softly across the page.

name: Chandelier night
description: Chandeliers glow above while paper sky lanterns and fireflies float up through the night.

name: Temple bells
description: Brass temple bells swing along the top as a kalash rises in a golden glow.

name: Peacock garden
description: A peacock fans its tail between blooming floral corners.

name: Parrots under the arch
description: Green parrots fly through a blooming floral arch.

name: Egrets and clouds
description: White egrets fly across a sky of soft drifting clouds.

name: Royal parasols
description: Royal parasols stand on either side under a marigold toran as flowers fall.

name: Haldi morning
description: A marigold toran drops in, marigolds tumble down and butterflies flutter, bright as a Haldi morning.

name: Mehendi garden
description: A henna mandala draws itself in while parrots fly between flowering corners.

name: Sangeet night
description: Chandeliers drop in over twinkling gold paisleys and sparkles, made for a Sangeet night.

name: Moonlit diyas
description: A crescent moon rises over a row of glowing diyas, with fireflies drifting up.

name: Gold paisley
description: Gold paisleys shimmer in the margins with soft sparkles.

name: Swans under the arch
description: Swans glide on a lotus lake beneath a blooming floral arch.

name: Moon and clouds
description: A golden moon rises behind soft drifting clouds, with fireflies.

name: Flower shower
description: Roses, peonies and marigolds shower down past blooming floral corners.

name: Elephants under the arch
description: Two decorated elephants meet beneath a blooming floral arch.

name: Royal court, silver
description: The royal court in silver: chandeliers and fans in cool, elegant tones.

name: Lotus lake at dusk
description: The lotus lake at dusk, in warm golden-hour colours.

name: Floral arch, pastel
description: The floral arch in soft pastels.

name: Garden corners, ivory
description: The garden corners in ivory and cream, quiet and elegant.

name: Toran, rose gold
description: The toran welcome in rose gold.
